title: RENDER: Controlling Reader-Facing Evidence in LLM Memory Evaluation
description:
arXiv:2608.23568v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Memory and RAG evaluations often treat the answering model's input as an implementation detail, even though systems may render the same history as a memory entry, summary, typed record, or raw excerpt. We introduce RENDER, a benchmark control that fixes the conversation while varying the reader-facing artifact.
